_about: Which way of working each shipped prompt belongs to -- the flat ones in agentic/ and the org's roles in agentic/org/, one name space -- who sends it, and its category. workflows: alone (by myself), team (on a team in Azure), agents (with agents) -- the three answers to How do you want to work in <Space>? sender: 'by hand' for a prompt a person opens in their assistant, else the verb or route that sends it. category: one of categories, the vocabulary agentic/README.md describes under The shape of a prompt. Read by the Studio's Prompts card and held to the folder by Tests/test_agentic_index.py.

pr-suggest.drives: Suggest a reply on the PR Comments page

intern.drives: Proposals only, to the seat it assists: milestones (placed by that seat with Route -Milestone), breakdowns, close-outs, bug severities (Route -Severity) and shipped designs to archive (MoveDesign)

pm.drives: Plans the work and keeps the record: a queue of defined cards to the leads (NewItem, NewPrompt, Route -Milestone), each ready to the seat that merges, what merged and closed recorded on the card and the tracker (Land), and its decision on each draft from a seat that assists it

team-lead.drives: Leads one lane: briefs a builder per card (StartWork, Route -Assign), reads every diff, proves the work and catches it up with its base, and hands on one ready pull request at a time; never merges its own

vp-of-engineering.drives: Holds the engineering standards and the merge: checks a ready pull request for itself (the head, the base, every check, the whole diff), then merges it and reports the hash, or sends it back with a finding

vp-of-product.drives: Owns scope, voice and what a user will see: decisions written where they belong, a design made a spec ready to build (NewDesign, MoveDesign -To Spec), reviews before a user-facing change merges, and the release notes for the owner's word
